item.title: Secure up to $100 in FREE credit ahead of Samsung’s CES 2026 releases
item.description: Samsung has now updated its official site with a teaser for some upcoming releases at CES 2026, and more importantly its latest Reserve Campaign with up to $100 in FREE Samsung credit to use towards them. We have already received a good look and some details on at least some of the upcoming Samsung reveals, and now you can go drop your email down to secure some no-strings-attached FREE credit. more…

item.title: First Kindle deals of the year now live: Latest base model $90, Kindle Scribe up to $140 off, Colorsoft $50 off
item.description: This morning Amazon is serving up the first deals of the year on Kindle devices. This includes the now previous-generation Kindle Scribe – it is quite similar to the newer and more pricey $499 model – at up to $140 off the list price alongside the latest base Kindle from $89.99 shipped and Kindle Colorsoft down at $199.99 shipped, or $50 off. more…

item.title: Google New Year deals roll on, but Amazon has even lower prices on latest Nest Cam Indoor at 25% off
item.description: While Black Friday and holiday pricing from last year on is new Nest Doorbell (Wired, 3rd Gen) has jumped up $10, you can still take advantage of holiday pricing on the latest Nest Cams. Both the Indoor and Outdoor models are still starting at Amazon lows. more…

item.title: Beats iPhone 17 Pro Max MagSafe Case w/ Camera Control now just $13 (71% off), more from $13.50
item.description: We featured more than a few deals on the latest batch of iPhone 17 Beats cases, but if you’re still looking to safeguard your new Apple handset or perhaps just scored one over the holidays, prices are seriously low right now. You can literally grab the matte finish Beats iPhone 17/Pro Max Cases with MagSafe and Camera Control starting from just $13 – that’s up to 71% off the list prices. more…

item.title: Last Chance – Official Nintendo New Year deals end tonight: Hollow Knight Silksong , Hades II, Mario, Minecraft, more
item.description: Nintendo launched its Hits of the Holiday sale a couple weeks ago and today is your last shot at it. This New Year deal event is set to end tonight so you had better get in there while you still can – there’s actually some great deals up for grabs here on sought-after titles like Hollow Knight: Silksong, Hades II – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, Mario games, and more. more…

item.title: Govee unveils new smart sky light with ‘true-to-life illumination indoors’ at CES 2026
item.description: CES 2026 is about to officially kick-off and the new product reveals are already starting. Next up, we are taking a look at the latest from smart lighting brand Govee with three new flagship products headlined by its most advanced floor lamp yet and a pair of Sky Ceiling Lights, one of which brings “true-to-life sky illumination indoors.” more…

item.title: CES 2026: Baseus unveils new desktop dock with onboard Qi2 25W MagSafe pad, more
item.description: Baseus has made a name around here for its breadth of charging and computing peripherals, many of which land at much lower price points than its competition. However, at CES 2026 it is unveiling a slate of new gear headlined by the new more powerful desktop docking solution that also happens to feature onboard 25W wireless 25W charging prowess. more…

item.title: CES 2026: Belkin debuts new display-equipped Nintendo Switch 2 case that doubles as a charging stand
item.description: Alongside the second-iteration of its latest 25W 3-in-1 charging stand (now with a modular wearable charging pad), Belkin is also revealing a brand new Nintendo Switch 2 charging case at CES 2026. This time around Belkin is taking a more integrated approach, complete with an onboard status display and the ability to charge the battery case without opening it. more…
